UPPER FACE. [8] [Kobalt.]
Red hard lumps on right cheek.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Kobalt.]
A large furuncle in region of left lower jaw.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Kobalt.]
Pain in hollow teeth, they feel too long ; gums swollen, tender, as if ulcerated ; < from cold air.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Kobalt.]
Qualmishness, with fulness of stomach.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Kobalt.]
Fulness in stomach, extending to throat ; qualmishness.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Kobalt.]
Shooting pains in hepatic region and sharp pain in region of spleen, < on taking a deep inspiration ; fulness in abdomen after a slight meal ; constant dropping of blood with stool. θ Hepatic derangement.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Kobalt.]
Costiveness alternating with diarrhœa.
Feces like hazelnuts, with dulness in head.
Constant dropping of blood from anus (stools not bloody).
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Kobalt.]
Scanty urine.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Kobalt.]
Frequent nocturnal emissions, with lewd dreams ; only partial or no erections ; impotence.
Seminal emissions at night, with headache and backache.
Impotence and emissions without erections.
Secondary gonorrhœa, with a greenish discharge.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Kobalt.]
Through chest fulness of stomach to throat.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Kobalt.]
Aching pain in small of back, or spine ; < sitting, > rising, walking or lying down.
Backache, with seminal emissions.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Kobalt.]
Distressing drowsiness, in evening, sleeps ten to eleven hours and still hardly able to get up in morning.
Disturbed, unrefreshing sleep.
Lewd dreams, emissions ; only partial or no erections.
